narrative.title: The Parking Garage Priority Audit
narrative.scenario: A garage stores vehicles in an array layout where slot i's children sit at fixed positions 2i+1 and 2i+2, and the garage rules demand that every occupied parent outrank its children. After reshuffling, an auditor must verify the layout still honors the hierarchy — walking each parent and comparing it against whichever children actually exist.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array A representing the layout.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if A satisfies the binary max-heap property, false otherwise.

complexity.optimalSpace: O(1) iterative / O(log n) recursion depth

testCases.explanation: Every parent (90, 15, 10) is strictly greater than its existing children.
The root 9 is smaller than its child 15, violating the hierarchy at the first slot.
